en: A vintage black and white postcard showing a group of uniformed sailors or cadets marching down a wide, tree-lined street. Elegant neoclassical buildings with balconies line the street to the left, while several people are seated at tables outside. In the background, a domed structure, likely a church or public building, is visible amid the trees. The postcard includes printed text in French at the bottom describing the location.
